arxiv-2305-12999.title: Integrated Guidance and Gimbal Control for Coverage Planning with Visibility Constraints Thanks: The authors are with the KIOS Research and Innovation Centre of Excellence (KIOS CoE) and the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Cyprus, Nicosia, 1678, Cyprus. {papaioannou.
arxiv-2305-12999.creator: Savvas Papaioannou, Panayiotis Kolios, Theocharis Theocharides
arxiv-2305-12999.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Savvas Papaioannou, Panayiotis Kolios, Theocharis Theocharides. Coverage path planning with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is a core task for many services and applications including search and rescue, precision agriculture, infrastructure inspection and surveillance. This work proposes an integrated guidance and gimbal control coverage path planning (CPP) approach, in which the mobility and gimbal inputs of an autonomous UAV agent are jointly controlled and optimized to achieve full coverage of a given object of interest, according to a specified set of optimality criteria.

arxiv-2312-10333.title: Logit-Based Alternatives to Two-Stage Least Squares
arxiv-2312-10333.creator: Denis Chetverikov, Jinyong Hahn, Zhipeng Liao, Shuyang Sheng
arxiv-2312-10333.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Denis Chetverikov, Jinyong Hahn, Zhipeng Liao, Shuyang Sheng. We propose logit-based IV and augmented logit-based IV estimators that serve as alternatives to the traditionally used 2SLS estimator in the model where both the endogenous treatment variable and the corresponding instrument are binary. Our novel estimators are as easy to compute as the 2SLS estimator but have an advantage over the 2SLS estimator in terms of causal interpretability.

arxiv-2403-13333.title: Repeating X-ray bursts: Interaction between a neutron star and clumps partially disrupted from a planet
arxiv-2403-13333.creator: Abdusattar Kurban, Xia Zhou, Na Wang, Yong-Feng Huang, Yu-Bin Wang, Nurimangul Nurmamat
arxiv-2403-13333.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Abdusattar Kurban, Xia Zhou, Na Wang, Yong-Feng Huang, Yu-Bin Wang, Nurimangul Nurmamat. Repeating X-ray bursts from the Galactic magnetar SGR 1806-20 have been observed with a period of 398 days. Similarly, periodic X-ray bursts from SGR 1935+2154 with a period of 238 days have also been observed. Here we argue that these X-ray bursts could be produced by the interaction of a neutron star (NS) with its planet in a highly elliptical orbit.

arxiv-2412-14947.title: Constraining 𝑩 B -Mesogenesis models with inclusive and exclusive decays.
arxiv-2412-14947.creator: Alexander Lenz, Ali Mohamed, Zachary Wüthrich
arxiv-2412-14947.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexander Lenz, Ali Mohamed, Zachary Wüthrich. The B B -Mesogenesis model explains the matter-antimatter asymmetry and leads to the right amount of dark matter in the Universe. In particular, this model predicts new decay channels of the b b quark. We investigate the modification of inclusive b b -hadron decay rates and of the lifetimes of different B B mesons due to these new decay channels and compare our results with available predictions for exclusive B B meson decays.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. After June 30, 1953, no construction of permanent housing may be begun under subchapter IX of this chapter. After July 31, 1954, (a) no mortgage may be insured under title IX of.

uslaw-usc-t49-s33105.title: 49 U.S.C. § 33105 — Cost limitations
uslaw-usc-t49-s33105.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s33105.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part C (Information, Standards, And Requirements); Chapter 331 (Theft Prevention). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Maximum Manufacturer Costs.— A standard under section 33102 or 33103 of this title may not impose— (1) on a manufacturer of motor vehicles, compliance costs of more than $15 a motor vehicle; or (2) on a manufacturer of major replacement.
